name: Athena Ladies Dormitory
address: 1060 Dos Castillas Street, Sampaloc, behind Dominican School, near UST A.H. Lacson gate
description: A women-only dorm a few minutes' walk from UST, with air-conditioned rooms of 15 to 18 sqm that have their own bathroom. Each floor has a shared kitchenette with a fridge, microwave and induction cooker, and a partner shop picks up laundry daily. A guard is on duty around the clock and CCTV covers all entrances.
houseRules: No guests inside rooms (lobby only). No curfew by default, but parents may request one. Electricity and water billed by actual use.

name: Dormus Boutique Student Dormitory
address: 1318-1324 España Boulevard, Sampaloc, across from UST
description: A boutique student dorm facing UST with fully furnished triple and quad rooms, each with an ensuite bathroom, double-deck beds, study desks and a window aircon. Floors are separated by gender and a roof deck serves as a lounge and study space. Entry is controlled by key cards and 24/7 CCTV.
houseRules: Visitors limited to common areas. Male and female residents on separate floors. No smoking or alcohol. Utilities not included in rent.

name: Habitus Living Spaces España
address: 3rd Floor Brickley 1 Building, 1372 España Blvd cor. Centro St, Sampaloc
description: A sister property of Dormus on España Boulevard, close to UST and FEU. Rooms are fully furnished with bunk beds, desks, an aircon unit and a private toilet and shower. The cheapest option is a big shared room offered on a one-year lease.
houseRules: Visitors limited to common areas. Male and female floors are separate. No smoking or alcohol. Utilities and maintenance fees not included.

name: SSB Dormhaus
address: 940 Padre Paredes Street, Sampaloc, near UST, FEU and UE
description: An affordable U-Belt dorm offering solo, double and four-person bedspace rooms, both aircon and non-aircon. It has a common study area, a pantry for cooking and round-the-clock security. Aircon rooms use electricity sub-meters while water is free.

name: Thomasian Residences
address: 1236 Santander Street, Sampaloc, 3-5 minutes' walk from UST Dapitan gate
description: A dorm for UST and FEU students and board exam reviewees, with removable beds that allow solo to quad occupancy. Rooms have aircon, lockable cabinets and study tables, and each room has its own water and electric meters. Fingerprint access, CCTV and a sprinkler system keep the building secure.

name: Trinity Place Ladies Dormitory
address: 1245-1253 Asturias Street, Sampaloc, near UST and Perpetual Help College
description: A high-rise ladies' dorm near UST with air-conditioned rooms, a private bathroom with heater, closets and study tables. There is a study room, laundry room and canteen, plus free WiFi in the lobby. The rate shown is half of the 18,000 monthly price for a double-occupancy room.
houseRules: No curfew. No visitors except immediate female family members. 12-month minimum contract.

name: Madrigal Ladies Dormitory
address: Magallanes Street, Intramuros, near Joy Christian Fellowship Church, walking distance to Mapúa
description: A low-cost ladies' boarding house inside Intramuros, convenient for students of Mapúa, Lyceum, PLM and Letran. It is a short walk from the area's food stops and the Cabildo Street dormtel branch.
